# Reminder Action

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ReminderAction`](gmeow-ReminderAction.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ReminderAction>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The action to take when a reminder fires — a VALUE vocabulary aligned to iCalendar ACTION, never a subclass.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ReminderAction`](gmeow-ReminderAction.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary [`gmeow:reminderAction`](../properties/gmeow-reminderAction.md) ranges over — the iCalendar ACTION kinds (display, email, audio) a reminder can fire.

### Avoid when

- Avoid modelling these as [`Reminder`](gmeow-Reminder.md) subclasses; the action is an individual on this axis, extended by minting new individuals ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded individual ([`gmeow:reminderActionDisplay`](../individuals/gmeow-reminderActionDisplay.md), [`gmeow:reminderActionEmail`](../individuals/gmeow-reminderActionEmail.md), [`gmeow:reminderActionAudio`](../individuals/gmeow-reminderActionAudio.md)) from [`gmeow:reminderAction`](../properties/gmeow-reminderAction.md).
